offering_description.value: Covista educates students for healthcare and veterinary careers through five accredited institutions. It works with health systems to recruit and enroll dedicated student cohorts and deliver clinical training in partner facilities.

quotes.quote: Covista is America's largest healthcare educator, serving 100,000 students through five accredited institutions: American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University.

Covista recruits and enrolls qualified candidates into a dedicated cohort for your health system. Your team gets to know applicants, and students complete clinical rotations in your facilities—taught by our faculty and yours, following your protocols. Throughout the program, students engage with your leadership through customized experiences that build institutional belonging before graduation. They’re ready to contribute from day one because they’ve already learned your workflows, technology systems and culture.

quotes.quote: Our outcomes demonstrate this commitment: a 97% first-time residency attainment rate* at our medical schools, #1 and #3 rankings for our nursing schools (Chamberlain and Walden) and the #1 provider of DVM graduates (Ross Veterinary).
